steps.what: Show which trucks and sorting stations this load uses.
Load and unload mail trucks, sometimes lifting containers onto equipment.
Move items on equipment that transports them to sorting stations.

tasks.design: The trucks and sorting stations for this load are shown from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The mail sorter loads and unloads the trucks, sometimes lifting containers onto equipment, and moves items on equipment that transports them to the sorting stations. A load with no bay id is handled from the instruction the sorter has. The screen does not lift.
tasks.previous_blocker: The bay and the station were known by the shift lead's call.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored load can name the truck and the station before the sorter lifts.
tasks.still_hard: Lifting a container onto the truck or the conveyor is physical work.
tasks.human_edge: The sorter loads, unloads, and moves the mail. A bay name does not lift it.
tasks.altitude: Loading stays with the sorter. The screen only names the truck and the station.

reach.task: Load a vehicle before a round.
reach.learn: A named bay is not the lift.

evidence.claim: A load record can name the truck and the sorting station. It cannot lift a container.
Moving mail onto equipment that transports it to a station stays with the sorter.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mail sorter on the floor of a mid-size European organisation. A code on a screen does not pick up, sort, or rewrap a piece of mail.
Fields: A load id is required before a bay is shown. With no id, the sorter follows the instruction they have. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mail sorter finishes it by hand.
Native check: The sorter does the lifting. The list does not assign the weight to a machine in this task.
unknowns: Whether containers are lifted by the sorter or by a dock machine the sorter drives.
research_questions: Which loads arrive with no bay id and are placed by a shouted instruction?

already_counted.description: Loading, unloading, and moving items to the stations stay with the sorter.

incremental.description: Check the bay list is this load, not the previous truck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes the load has no bay id, so the sorter works from the shift lead's instruction. High assumes the truck and station are shown. The lifting is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the pigeonhole for the route code already read.
Distribute incoming mail into the correct boxes or pigeonholes.
Hold incoming mail the route code does not place.

tasks.design: Where a route code is already read, {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the pigeonhole. The mail sorter distributes incoming mail into the correct boxes or pigeonholes, and holds mail the code does not place. A code with no pigeonhole is not given a box. The screen does not place the piece.
tasks.previous_blocker: The sorter remembered the scheme, and a scheme change meant mis-filed mail.
tasks.enabler_now: A route code already read can point at the current pigeonhole.
tasks.still_hard: Picking up the piece and putting it in the box is the sorter's hands.
tasks.human_edge: The sorter places the mail. A shown box is not the placement.
tasks.altitude: Distribution stays in the sorter's hands. The screen names the box for a code already read.

reach.task: Put an item in the right compartment.
reach.learn: A named box is not the hand that places the item.

evidence.claim: A route code already read can be shown against the current pigeonhole. It cannot place the piece.
Mail with no matching box stays in the sorter's hands.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mail sorter on the floor of a mid-size European organisation. A code on a screen does not pick up, sort, or rewrap a piece of mail.
Fields: A route code is required. With no code, the sorter places the piece as they do today. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mail sorter finishes it by hand.
Native check: The shown box is the one stored for that code. The sorter still puts the mail in it.
unknowns: Whether every incoming piece has a route code before it reaches the pigeonholes.
research_questions: Which pieces are held because the code has no box?

already_counted.description: Placing the mail and holding the unplaced pieces stay with the sorter.

incremental.description: Check the shown box is the current scheme, not yesterday's.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes pieces have no route code, so the sorter uses memory and nothing is saved. High assumes the pigeonhole is shown. Placing each piece by hand is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the rewrap station and the materials for this parcel.
Rewrap soiled or broken parcels by hand.
Set aside a parcel that cannot be rewrapped.

tasks.design: The rewrap station and its materials are shown from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The mail sorter rewraps soiled or broken parcels by hand, and sets aside a parcel that cannot be rewrapped. A station with no id is found as the sorter already knows it. The screen does not wrap the parcel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Materials were found by walking, and a parcel that could not be saved was mixed back in.
tasks.enabler_now: The station can be named. The wrapping stays in the sorter's hands.
tasks.still_hard: A torn or soiled wrap has to be replaced by hand, and some parcels cannot be saved.
tasks.human_edge: The sorter rewraps the parcel or sets it aside. A station name does not wrap it.
tasks.altitude: Rewrapping stays by hand. The screen only names the station.

reach.task: Deal with a damaged item before it travels.
reach.learn: A station name is not the repair.

evidence.claim: A floor record can name the rewrap station. It cannot wrap a parcel.
A soiled or broken parcel is rewrapped by hand, or set aside by the sorter.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mail sorter on the floor of a mid-size European organisation. A code on a screen does not pick up, sort, or rewrap a piece of mail.

Fields: A station id is required before materials are shown. With no id, the sorter goes to the station they know. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mail sorter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Every rewrap is done by hand. No step wraps the parcel.
unknowns: Whether rewrap materials are tracked as stock or only kept at the bench.
research_questions: Which parcels are set aside because they cannot be made fit to travel?

already_counted.description: Rewrapping and setting aside unsaved parcels stay with the sorter.

incremental.description: Check the named station is the rewrap bench for this shift.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes there is no station id, so nothing is shown and the hand rewrap is unchanged. High assumes the station is named. The wrapping stays by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the station steps a new worker is to be shown.
Train new workers on the sorting stations.
Note which station steps were shown.

tasks.design: Station steps already written for the floor are listed from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The mail sorter trains new workers on the sorting stations by showing those steps. The sorter notes which steps were shown, in {DOCS}. A station with no step id is taught from memory. The list does not train, and it does not score the new worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each sorter taught from memory, so a new worker missed a step.
tasks.enabler_now: A written station list can be shown. The sorter still does the showing.
tasks.still_hard: Showing how to handle live mail is a conversation at the machine.
tasks.human_edge: The sorter trains the new worker. A list of steps is not the demonstration.
tasks.altitude: Training stays with the sorter. The list only shows steps the floor has already written, and the note does not score anyone.

reach.task: Show a new clerk the counter.
reach.learn: A step list is not the demonstration, and it is not a score.

evidence.claim: A station list the organisation has already written can be shown. It cannot demonstrate the work.
The note records which steps were shown. It is not an evaluation of the new worker, and it is not a roster scored on behaviour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mail sorter on the floor of a mid-size European organisation. A code on a screen does not pick up, sort, or rewrap a piece of mail.
Fields: A station id is required. With no written steps, the sorter teaches from memory. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mail sorter finishes it by hand.
Native check: The note lists steps shown. It does not store a score, a trait, or a ranking of the worker.
The note is about the item or the machine. It is not a score of the sorter.
unknowns: Whether a written station list exists or each sorter still teaches from memory.
research_questions: Which station steps are still only in a sorter's head?

already_counted.description: Training the new worker and noting the steps shown stay with the sorter.

incremental.description: Check the step list is for the station the new worker will stand at.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes the station has no written steps, so the sorter teaches from memory. High assumes the list is shown. The demonstration and the note of what was shown are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mail sorter still loads the truck, still places mail in the pigeonhole, still rewraps a broken parcel, and still trains the new worker. A station list can name the steps to show. It does not lift, wrap, or teach.
reach: Postal service mail carriers load a vehicle for a round, and this job learns a bay name is not the lift.
Postal service clerks show a new colleague the counter, and this job learns a step list is not the training.
skills_to_grow: Lift and place mail, including pieces a code does not cover.
Rewrap a soiled or broken parcel by hand.
Train a new worker by showing the station, without scoring them.
role.ambitious_version: A new worker is shown the station steps from one list, and every parcel that is soiled or broken is still rewrapped by hand.

job.title: Postal Service Mail Sorters, Processors, and Processing Machine Operators
